operations.name: Kellen Sorber

expected.charges: Arson of a building used in interstate commerce (18 U.S.C. § 844(i))
expected.sentence: 44 months imposed March 18, 2019 for the September 6, 2018 fire at the Albany County Republican Party headquarters. Official BOP register 17324-091 reports no longer in BOP custody as of December 10, 2021. Exact arrest and initial jail admission remain unresolved; the incident date and late-October search announcements are not recorded as arrest dates.

operations.source: https://jackfmcasper.com/federal-judge-detains-man-charged-with-burning-albany-county-gop-office/ — November 1, 2018 report explicitly dates surrender October 25 and continued custody, citing detention hearing minutes. https://k2radio.com/man-charged-with-burning-albany-county-gop-headquarters-set-for-court/ corroborates surrender. https://www.justice.gov/usao-wy/pr/republican-party-headquarters-arsonist-sentenced-us-district-court verifies sentencing judge and November 15 indictment. Existing release date preserved.

operations.name: Christopher Doyon

expected.charges: Computer hacking — 2010 DDoS attack that took down the Santa Cruz County website, as "Commander X" of the People's Liberation Front / Anonymous

updates.sentence: One year of probation for the Santa Cruz County computer-damage case, concurrent with probation in CR 22-00099 and supervised release in CR 12-00426. This judgment imposes probation rather than a new prison term.

operations.source: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCOURTS-cand-5_11-cr-00683/pdf/USCOURTS-cand-5_11-cr-00683-5.pdf — judgment pages 1-2, imposed June 28, 2022. Downloaded and visually checked page 2. Populated June 27 sentencing/release fields conflict by one day; left unchanged and flagged in the audit, as this batch fills missing fields only.

operations.name: Bill Dunne

updates.sentence: Ninety years for the 1979 attempted prisoner liberation; an additional consecutive fifteen years resulted from the 1983 escape attempt, according to Dunne’s 1985 account.

operations.source: https://freedomarchives.org/Documents/Finder/DOC3_scans/3.cant.jail.spirit.1985.pdf — Bill Dunne first-person account, PDF page 71, states 90 years plus consecutive 15. Jericho summary corroborates 90 years, although its separate federal component is described as 80; do not label the entire 90 as a single federal sentence. His account dates capture October 14, conflicting with existing October 13 fields, which are preserved and flagged.

operations.name: Bill Dunne

expected.name: Bill Dunne
expected.description: Bill Dunne is an anarchist political prisoner who has been incarcerated since 1979, when he was sentenced to 90 years for the attempted armed liberation of a comrade from the King County Jail in Seattle. A 1983 escape attempt from USP Lewisburg added 15 years. Repeatedly denied parole — most recently told he will not be reconsidered until 2029 — and denied clemency, he was diagnosed with cancer in 2024.

operations.source: https://www.abcf.net/blog/message-from-political-prisoner-bill-dunne-for-running-down-the-walls-2025/ — published message from Dunne identifies this register number; corroborated by his signed 2007 message https://freedomarchives.org/Documents/Finder/DOC511_scans/511.SF8.SolidaritySupportJustice.pdf .

operations.name: Carolyn Rodriguez

expected.sentence: Arrested June 23, 2024 in Fort Worth and booked into jail after hospital treatment, held overnight until release the next day.

updates.charges: Interference with public duties (Texas Penal Code § 38.15); false alarm or report (acquitted); resisting arrest (abandoned by the prosecution before trial).

operations.source: https://law.justia.com/cases/texas/sixth-court-of-appeals/2025/06-25-00020-cr.html — November 24, 2025 appellate opinion, opening and notes 3 and 11, establishes charges, dispositions, and judge who presided over trial. Existing June 22-23 custody fields conflict with June 23 arrest account; preserved and flagged. No claim that abandoned or acquitted counts produced a conviction.

expected.name: Michel Shehadeh
expected.description: Michel Shehadeh was arrested and imprisoned with the Los Angeles Eight in January 1987. The government's effort to deport him over alleged political support for a Palestinian organization became a prolonged First Amendment and due-process dispute. The remaining proceedings against Shehadeh and Khader Hamide ended in October 2007. He was not incarcerated throughout the twenty years of litigation, and this record does not flag current custody.
expected.body:
Case history and verification

Michel Shehadeh was arrested and imprisoned with the Los Angeles Eight in January 1987. The government's effort to deport him over alleged political support for a Palestinian organization became a prolonged First Amendment and due-process dispute. The remaining proceedings against Shehadeh and Khader Hamide ended in October 2007. He was not incarcerated throughout the twenty years of litigation, and this record does not flag current custody.

Status reviewed October 8, 2026: Historical case. The profile records the last documented outcome; no current ICE custody is asserted.

Sources

  • ACLU of Southern California: LA8 arrest and dismissal history

Verified detail sources (October 8, 2026): ACLU Southern California’s October 31, 2007 announcement explicitly describes Khader Hamide and Michel Shehadeh as two men, identifying the LA8 proceedings. The dismissal date is not treated as a release from custody. Source 1.
